from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
ROOT=Path('${CBUS_REPOSITORY_ROOT}');TK=ROOT/'toolkit-cli';OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SIX=Path('${CBUS_DIFFERENTIAL_ROOT}')
sys.path[:0]=[str(TK),str(TK/'src')]
from research.sanitize_evidence_receipts import _validator,sanitize,local_coordinate_fields
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
m=json.loads((SIX/'raw-run-manifest.json').read_text());assert m['complete'] is True
assert m['source_before']==m['source_after'] and m['binary_before']==m['binary_after']
assert all(r['exit_status']==0 and r['producer_waited'] for r in m['runs'])
result=[]
for row in m['candidates']:
 raw=Path(row['raw_path']);candidate=Path(row['candidate_path']);v=json.loads(raw.read_bytes());public=json.loads(candidate.read_bytes())
 assert sha(raw)==row['raw_sha256'] and sha(candidate)==row['candidate_sha256']
 _validator(row['kind'])(v);_validator(row['kind'])(public)
 assert not local_coordinate_fields(public)
 assert sanitize(raw.read_bytes(),kind=row['kind'],private_raw_dir=SIX/'raw-archive')==candidate.read_bytes()
 for name,digest in v['source_fingerprint'].items():assert sha(ROOT/name)==digest,name
 name=candidate.name.replace('cgate-tagged-session-differential-mock.json','cgate-tagged-session-differential-cgate-mock.json')
 target=TK/'research/fixtures'/name;target.write_bytes(candidate.read_bytes());assert target.read_bytes()==candidate.read_bytes()
 result.append({'path':str(target.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(target),'raw_sha256':sha(raw),'source_bindings':len(v['source_fingerprint'])})
binding_count=sum(r['source_bindings'] for r in result)
(OUT/'root-six-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'result':'passed','receipts':result,'source_bindings':binding_count,'raw_public_sanitizer_byte_identical':True,'cleanup_qualification':m['cleanup_qualification']},indent=2)+'\n')
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('CBUS_') and k not in ('PYTHONHOME','PYTHONPATH')};env.update(PYTHONPATH='src:tests:.',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
records=[]
for label,args in (
 ('skip-census',['research/skip_census.py']),
 ('inventory',['research/build_cgate_contract_inventory.py']),
 ('physical-applicability',['research/cgate_session_physical_applicability.py','--output','research/fixtures/cgate-session-physical-applicability.json']),
 ('parity',['research/build_parity_register.py']),
 ('skip-census-check',['research/skip_census.py','--check']),
 ('inventory-check',['research/build_cgate_contract_inventory.py','--check']),
 ('parity-check',['research/build_parity_register.py','--check']),
 ('coverage',['-m','cbus_toolkit','coverage','--require-complete'])):
 argv=[str(TK/'.venv/bin/python'),*args]
 with (OUT/(label+'.stdout')).open('wb') as stdout,(OUT/(label+'.stderr')).open('wb') as stderr:
  r=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=TK,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
 records.append({'label':label,'argv':argv,'cwd':str(TK),'exit_status':r.returncode,'stdout_sha256':sha(OUT/(label+'.stdout')),'stderr_sha256':sha(OUT/(label+'.stderr'))})
 (OUT/'generation-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
 assert r.returncode==(1 if label=='coverage' else 0),label
assert sha(TK/'research/release-gates/native.json')=='f720bc657a2613a5cbcf361173cbc936f0971ac056757b85cbac6537b60b756c'
print(json.dumps({'six_bindings':binding_count,'generators':'passed','native_manifest_unchanged':True,'coverage_expected_exit':1}))
